# detroit.primals.eco — Public Evidence Library

> Cash for Kids 2: A Public Record — documenting racketeering in Detroit charter schools

This site is the public evidence library for a federal racketeering investigation
targeting a network of convicted felons, corrupt judges, and captured institutions
extracting millions in public education dollars from Detroit's most vulnerable children.

## Sections

- [Open Letters](https://detroit.primals.eco/open-letters/): Letters to public figures connected to the network, published after private delivery
- [Evidence Library](https://detroit.primals.eco/evidence/): Public-record documents organized by category
- [Network Map](https://detroit.primals.eco/network/): Actors, judges, institutions, and their connections
- [Timeline](https://detroit.primals.eco/timeline/): Chronology of events, filings, and discoveries
- [Book Analysis](https://detroit.primals.eco/books/): Analysis of books by network members — zero victims named
- [Verify Everything](https://detroit.primals.eco/validate/): Links and instructions for independent verification via OTIS, LARA, PACER, ROD
- [About](https://detroit.primals.eco/about/): Methodology — one person, public records, 30 days
- [Contact](https://detroit.primals.eco/contact/): For harmed parties, media, and whistleblowers

## Source Repository

All documents are git-signed and timestamped at:
https://git.primals.eco/publicRecord/detroit

Clone the repo to verify everything independently.

## Key Entities

- Purpose Charter Academy (PCA) — K-5 charter school, Detroit
- MacDowell Preparatory Academy — K-8 charter school, Detroit
- Brian Banks — superintendent, 9 convictions (6 felony, 3 misdemeanor), fake J.D. and Ph.D.
- Joseph Holland — financial officer, convicted drug offender (MDOC #443789, Controlled Substance — Possession)
- Tonesa Welch — BMF figure, Banks' aunt (through his father OD Banks, BMF Defendant #22)

## Infrastructure

Built on ecoPrimals infrastructure (https://sporeprint.primals.eco).
Static site generated with Zola, served via Caddy with TLS.
